manifest.method: Authoritative headless reducer; bots see only their own player view. Each seed is played all-Balanced and once per challenger seat with Balanced in every other seat; seats are 1-based. Ties split wins.

method: Each seed is played all-Balanced and with the challenger in one seat; Balanced plays every other seat. Win shares split ties. Approximate 95% game-level normal intervals; paired intervals use within-seed differences against Balanced in the same seat and seed. Exploratory bot-versus-bot simulation, not a human population estimate.
